verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that an official Stripe CLI is documented at docs.stripe.com/stripe-cli. As part of the Stripe platform, Issuing users can reach it, and it sits alongside an official MCP server and llms.txt for agent workflows. The CLI evidence is only a single existence probe, though. Missing for 10: details of Issuing-specific CLI commands (e.g., creating cards or cardholders, simulating authorizations), documentation of CLI usage in AI or agent workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
